short-description: The Denver Cowboy is set in the George Schleier Mansion, an 1880s Capitol Hill landmark full of original woodwork, hand-carved details, gargoyles, and a grand cupola.
long-description: The Denver Cowboy is set in the George Schleier Mansion, an 1880s Capitol Hill landmark full of original woodwork, hand-carved details, gargoyles, and a grand cupola. Stay in a custom-designed suite and wander out back to the Public House for cocktails and wood-fired pizza. The Cowboy has always been about freedom; it’s a special place for travelers, dreamers, and romantics. You’ll always find a welcome mat at our door.
name: Denver

long-description: The Nashville Cowboy is set in an 1800s Queen Anne Victorian mansion, tucked in the heart of historic East Nashville. Stay in a custom-designed suite, catch live music in the Parlor Wine bar, and enjoy award-winning cocktails and Michelin star pizza at Urban Cowboy Public House. The spirit of The Cowboy has always been about freedom. We're an oasis for travelers, dreamers, and romantics. You’ll always find a welcome mat at our door.
name: Nashville East

short-description: So you’ve already hit Broadway, what’s next? Come experience downtown Nashville’s only Cowboy Bar.
long-description: So you’ve already hit Broadway, what’s next? Come experience downtown Nashville’s only Cowboy Bar. Kick back in our ground-floor saloon with a drink and a slice of Frankies pizza, then head upstairs to our award-winning cocktail bar with the best view in Nashville.
name: Nashville Downtown

short-description: Built in 1898, Urban Cowboy Lodge & Resort sits deep in a Catskills valley, with the Esopus Creek running right through it.
long-description: Built in 1898, Urban Cowboy Lodge & Resort sits deep in a Catskills valley, with the Esopus Creek running right through it. Just two and a half hours from New York City, it feels a world away. Cowboy has always been about freedom: a place for travelers, dreamers, romantics, and anyone looking to disappear for a while. Come for the mountains, the water, the quiet, or the company. However you find your way here, there’s always a welcome mat at the door.
location-details: The Catskills are made for disappearing for a while: winding mountain roads, wooded trails, swimming holes, small towns, good food, and plenty of open space. Close enough for a weekend, far enough to feel gone.
feature-paragraph-1: Trade pavement for mountain air and the kind of quiet that makes you forget what day it is.
feature-paragraph-2: Sauna, outdoor hangs, long baths and plenty of ways to slow the whole operation down.
feature-paragraph-3: Dinner, drinks, fireside nights and whatever happens next. Cowboy is made for gathering.
name: Catskills
